segments.text: And deliuered iust Lot, vexed with the vncleane conuersation of the wicked.

And the Lord said vnto him: goe through the middest of the cittie, euen through the middest of Ierusalem, and set a marke vpon the foreheads of them that mourne and crie for all the abominations that be done in the middest thereof.
